description:
This video highlights viral contraband busts. Officers uncover drugs and weapons hidden in sea salt bags, coolers, foil packages, and kids’ toys.  In addition, field operations track narcotics washing up in the Florida Keys, revealing how far smugglers will go.
#ContrabandSeizedAtTheAirport #ContrabandSeizedAttheBorder #Discovery

About Contraband: Seized at the Airport & Contraband: Seized at the Border
Contraband: Seized at the Airport is a behind-the-scenes look at the Department of Homeland Security’s search for domestic and foreign contraband. Meanwhile, Contraband: Seized at the Border follows America’s Customs and Border Protection officers as they face drug smugglers, intoxicated travelers, and wanted criminals at the U.S./Mexico border.
